name: Jenko "edleft" Hwong
biography: Jenko Hwong is a Principal Security Researcher at Huntress Labs, focusing on identity-based attacks and cloud abuse. Prior to Huntress, he spent 6 years at Netskope Threat Labs, has spoken at RSA and DEFCON, and is a Cloud Village Lead. He has over 20 years at various security startups in cloud detection/response, vulnerability scanning, AV/AS, pen-testing/exploits, L3/4 appliances, threat intel, and windows security.
